statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of seven paths/templates. Not covered: paywalled subscriber-only states, comment posting, destructive account actions, and live video playback because they require credentials or consequential actions.

paths.description: Homepage: primary news landing template, global navigation, ads, preferences, mobile layout, network/performance/security and carousel interaction.
News section listing template representing category indexes.
Representative news article and primary reading journey, including metadata and no-JavaScript content.
Primary search flow with a populated query and result list.
Account/sign-in form, input assistance, auth options and empty-submit validation.
Recovery path for a missing URL, including true HTTP status and navigation options.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains a white/red light theme; the dark probe reports color-scheme: normal and unchanged light foreground/surface values while prefers-color-scheme: dark matches.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens for page, controls, ads placeholders, and embedded surfaces.

findings.summary: Interactive movement is library-driven and lacks modern transition and scroll primitives.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no View Transition rules, container/scroll timelines, or running document animations; the carousel is implemented with the shipped Swiper library.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route/state changes with View Transitions and implement scroll/gesture behaviour with CSS scroll timelines, scroll snap, and platform overscroll where appropriate.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to reading position and overlays are not anchor-positioned.
findings.evidence: Desktop and article captures show a static two-row header without reading progress; CSS inspection found no modern positioning/state rules and no popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scroll-state-aware compact header/progress cue and use CSS anchor positioning with fallbacks for transient menus and tooltips.

findings.summary: Advertising and custom fixed widgets overwhelm and obscure the core news content.
findings.evidence: The first article viewport gives most of its height to a large ad; homepage/search screenshots show a fixed Biz Chat control and a bottom video overlay covering results. DOM reports zero dialog/popover/details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer nonessential ads/widgets, cap their occupied area, avoid autoplay/sticky media, and implement transient controls with dialog/popover and clear light-dismiss.

findings.summary: The narrow layout overflows and keyboard/touch affordances are weak.
findings.evidence: At 360×800 the layout primitive measured scrollWidth 1296 versus a 360px visual viewport, 936px horizontal overflow. The focus probe found many links with outline none and controls as small as 18×18 or 24×24. No container queries were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove desktop minimum widths, make navigation intentionally scrollable without enlarging the document, use container queries for cards, provide visible :focus-visible styles, and make touch targets at least 44px.

findings.summary: Loading and interaction performance miss modern responsiveness targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.5s, TBT 1,230ms, Speed Index 21.9s, 27.2s main-thread work and 13.3s JavaScript execution. The trace corroborated a 4.47s LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile long tasks, split and defer noncritical script, prioritise the LCP asset, and schedule analytics/ad work after core content and interaction readiness.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is dominated by unused code and third-party dependencies.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 276 requests and 3.85MB transferred, including 86 scripts/2.26MB and 270 third-party requests. Lighthouse found 1,165KiB potential unused-JS savings, 1,250ms render-blocking savings, and 2,219KiB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate/unused vendor tags, load optional integrations on demand, self-host/subset fonts where appropriate, and tighten cache and priority policy.

findings.summary: Multiple interactive elements lack accessible names and structural labelling.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found five unnamed links, two untitled iframes, and one visible-label/accessibility-name mismatch. The DOM probe counted 30 links without a usable name and search inputs have no associated label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon link and iframe a purpose-specific accessible name/title, add real labels for search inputs, and keep visible and accessible names aligned.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum colour contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found nine contrast failures, including #9f9f9f on #f5f5f5 at 2.42:1 and red timestamps on beige at 3.61:1, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and add automated contrast coverage for recurring card/tab components.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and reflow are not reliable.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe reports outline none on the menu button and navigation links; the 360px layout has 936px horizontal overflow. This prevents dependable keyboard orientation and narrow/zoomed reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Define strong :focus-visible styles that survive theme colours and ensure all content reflows at narrow/zoomed widths without document-level horizontal scrolling.

findings.summary: The page logs runtime errors and uses deprecated browser APIs.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded ten console/network errors and four deprecations, including unload listeners, Topics, Attribution Reporting, and Shared Storage; it also found a BFCache failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers, update or remove obsolete ad/analytics integrations, handle failed vendor responses, and restore BFCache eligibility.

findings.summary: Image/document asset hygiene has avoidable defects.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 7 images without dimensions, 42 without alt, 75 without srcset and 15 below-fold images not lazy-loaded; Lighthouse independently found unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, meaningful or empty alt as appropriate, responsive srcset/sizes, and lazy loading for below-fold editorial media.

findings.summary: The public homepage lacks an H1 and mobile crawlability is undermined by overflow.
findings.evidence: Discoverability found server-rendered title/description and 100% raw-content coverage, but both recon and discoverability recorded zero H1 elements. The mobile layout overflows by 936px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive homepage H1 (visually integrated, not keyword stuffing) and fix narrow reflow while preserving real href links and server-rendered content.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers and cookie protections are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy headers. Cookie audit found 30 of 31 cookies insecure, many SameSite=None and several lasting 390–400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive report-tested CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark every HTTPS cookie Secure and minimise SameSite=None/lifetimes.

findings.summary: The default page load exposes readers to an extreme tracking and advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture contacted 109 third-party origins and identified 26 known tracker domains. HAR attributes 270 of 276 requests and 3.74MB of 3.85MB to third parties, before any explicit reader action.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt data minimisation by default, gate nonessential trackers behind valid consent, consolidate vendors, batch analytics, and publish a measurable third-party budget.

findings.summary: Authentication offers no phishing-resistant passkey option.
findings.evidence: The login probe found a labelled email flow with autocomplete=email and social sign-in choices, but no WebAuthn/passkey affordance or implementation signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication as a primary option, with existing identity-provider/email flows retained as recovery fallbacks.

findings.summary: Custom sticky overlays make runtime behaviour fragile.
findings.evidence: Search and homepage captures show a custom bottom video layer and fixed chat widget overlapping the content; DOM reports no dialog/popover primitives that provide top-layer semantics and platform dismissal.
findings.suggestedFix: Use top-layer dialog/popover primitives, reserve layout space for persistent media, restore focus on close, and test edge positioning at every viewport.

findings.summary: The news experience is not available offline despite shipping a manifest.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found a manifest link but no active service worker; therefore no offline fallback is available for previously visited articles or a network-failure shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a small service worker with an offline fallback and conservative caching for app shell and recently read articles; keep live news network-first.

findings.summary: Layout CSS is not prepared for bidirectional or alternate writing modes.
findings.evidence: The platform probe confirms lang=sr but finds physical CSS properties and no logical inline/block properties; dir is not explicitly declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the intended direction and replace physical left/right/width-dependent component rules with logical properties and translation-tolerant sizing.

findings.summary: Submitting the empty sign-in form gives no visible, actionable feedback.
findings.evidence: After activating Continue with an empty email field, the captured login page shows no inline required-field message, error summary, or invalid state; the input is not marked required.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required/email constraints, validate after interaction, display a specific inline message, set aria-invalid, and announce errors through a live region.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bandwidth across a media-heavy homepage.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 75/100 images without srcset, 15 below-fold images eager-loaded, 7 missing dimensions and 3 oversized; Lighthouse estimated 371KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, emit width-aware srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold images, and preserve dimensions while prioritising only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and media are disproportionate to the core reading experience.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 270 third-party requests, 86 scripts, 83 fetches and 3.74MB third-party transfer; screenshots show large/sticky advertising and video occupying content space. Lighthouse saw a 31MB payload under its throttled run.
findings.suggestedFix: Set enforceable third-party request/byte/CPU budgets, remove low-value vendors, load ads/media only near view or after consent, and stop sticky/autoplay media by default.

findings.summary: The homepage has a disproportionate memory footprint.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contains about 1.21 million nodes, 5.60 million edges and 63.2MB self size for a news homepage. A repeated 10× carousel next/back run did not increase the footprint, but the steady-state allocation remains high.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendor runtimes and duplicate trackers, virtualise long feeds, destroy offscreen widgets/iframes, and establish a heap/node budget in regression tests.
